ns2:section.sectionText: Restricted to College of ACES until June 29, 2020, with many seats reserved for new ACES freshmen in June. This section has combined evening exams from 7pm-8pm on the following Thursdays: Sept 24, Oct 22, Nov 19. This section has a blended format in which part of the content is delivered in lecture and discussion, and part is delivered online. Some seats are reserved for ACES students; any remaining seats will be released during business hours on the Friday before fall classes begin.
